title: Artificial Condition
author: Martha Wells
summary: The second Murderbot novella. A security android that secretly hacked its own control system tries to uncover what happened in its past, travelling with the help of a very opinionated spaceship intelligence. It's a short, sardonic read.
readIf: you want a sarcastic, short sci-fi read about an AI that would rather watch TV than fight.
skipIf: you haven't read the first novella, which sets up the central character and its secret.

pairings.reason: Shares the dry, deadpan humour and a reluctant protagonist dragged through space against their will.
A warm, crew-centred space story that also treats nonhuman characters with real tenderness.
Another thoughtful sci-fi book about non-human intelligence, but sweeping and serious across generations.
